messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Next time you see those people you invited but didn't show up, ask them point blank why they didn't even bother to show up for 5 minutes.

output.original_text: Next time you see those people you invited but didn't show up, ask them point blank why they didn't even bother to show up for 5 minutes.
output.joy: Next time you see those people you invited but didn't show up, cheerfully ask them why they didn’t make it, even for just 5 minutes!
output.sadness: Next time you see those people you invited but didn't show up, softly ask them why they couldn’t even spare 5 minutes for us.
output.fear: Next time you see those people you invited but didn't show up, cautiously ask them why they didn’t even take 5 minutes to come.
output.anger: Next time you see those people you invited but didn’t show up, bluntly demand to know why they didn’t even bother to come for 5 minutes!
output.surprise: Next time you see those people you invited but didn't show up, surprisingly ask them why they didn’t show up, not even for 5 minutes!
output.disgust: Next time you see those people you invited but didn't show up, ask them with disdain why they didn’t even have the decency to show up for 5 minutes.
